reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so asking ₹12,990 for a two-person firm feels like a steep premium, especially when I have avoided third-party cloud tools for years out of fear of data leaks. Until I verify the Google Drive sandboxing on the free pilot and see real time saved on my Saturday GST reconciliations, I will not pay double Jamku's rate upfront.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
would_change_my_mind: A solo practitioner plan priced closer to Jamku's ₹6,500, combined with verified proof that Google Drive permissions can never leak confidential files and that it solves my Saturday GST tracking.
